page.overview:
Who is Cabriana Mecandes?

Cabriana Mecandes was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She had long golden hair and pale blue eyes, which was fairly rare for a Tairen.

Cabriana was very weak in the One Power, with a strength in the One Power of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing. Moiraine describes her as "not very strong at all".

Cabriana has the Talent of fast learning., Cabriana Mecandes}}
